steps.note: Open the prepared closed two-bid event directly on Master QCS.
Enable the required eRFX project setting before accessing the prepared event.
Confirm both bidding vendors are present with real names.
Verify Vendor B's offered quantity on the available line.
Verify Vendor B's rate is 90 on the available line.
Open the awarding screen for the closed event.
Allocate the available line's full requested quantity to Vendor B.
Check that one available line and one vendor are selected and the proposal value is 900.
Create the award proposal from the allocation.
Complete mandatory proposal fields before submission.
Submit the proposal so it can enter approval.
Confirm the submitted proposal is pending approval.

args.need: leave the approval remark empty and approve the proposal as the approver, confirming the refusal 'Remark is necessary for approval' and that the proposal remains pending
